results.reply:
The top five all score high on the feel-good and comedy tags, and most also score well on funny. They range from warm family stories to a sharp comedy about a repeating day, so you get a few different flavours of the wish.

**Little Miss Sunshine** — Scores 92% feel-good, 91% comedy and 81% funny, and centres on a stressed mother and her family.
**Intouchables** — Scores the highest feel-good match here at 97%, with 86% comedy, and follows a driver and a quadriplegic man whose wild night drive turns into a friendship.
**Crazy, Stupid, Love.** — Scores 92% feel-good and 94% comedy, and begins with a middle-aged husband reeling after his wife asks for a divorce.
**Groundhog Day** — Scores 88% feel-good, 97% comedy and 81% funny, and follows a cynical TV weatherman stuck reliving the same day in Pittsburgh.
**Hunt for the Wilderpeople** — Scores 87% feel-good, 93% comedy and 84% funny, and follows a runaway foster child who is taken in by a new couple in New Zealand.

judge.reason: Every film is a well-regarded comedy or comedy-drama known for warmth and an uplifting tone (Little Miss Sunshine, Intouchables, Groundhog Day, Wilderpeople), with Crazy, Stupid, Love as a solidly rated crowd-pleaser, so the list fits the wish very well.
